title: Electrolyzer Setup Builder
description: Create your own electrolyzer models by combining a base unit and auxiliary equipments.

configuration_name.label: Configuration Name
configuration_name.tooltip: The name under which this configuration will be saved.

technology_type.label: Technology Type
technology_type.tooltip: The type of electrolyzer technology (PEM, Alkaline, AEM, SOEC).

stack_power.label: Stack Power
stack_power.tooltip: The electrical power required to operate a single cell stack.

max_capacity.label: Max Capacity (Possible Stacks)
max_capacity.tooltip: The maximum number of stacks that the base unit can physically accommodate.

included_stacks.label: Number of Stacks included
included_stacks.tooltip: The number of stacks actually installed in the initial configuration.

total_power.label: Total Power
total_power.tooltip: The total electrical capacity of the machine.

base_water_consumption.label: Base Water Consumption
base_water_consumption.tooltip: The water consumption of the electrolyzer alone, excluding its auxiliaries.

energy_consumption.label: Energy Consumption
energy_consumption.tooltip: The electrical energy required to produce one kilogram of hydrogen.

single_stack_price.label: Single Stack Price
single_stack_price.tooltip: The unit purchase cost for a single stack.

global_maintenance.label: Global Maintenance
global_maintenance.tooltip: Percentage of CAPEX (total cost) allocated each year for maintenance.

stack_lifetime.label: Stack Lifetime
stack_lifetime.tooltip: The estimated number of operating hours before a stack replacement is required.

component_name.label: Component Name
component_name.tooltip: The name of the additional auxiliary equipment.

price.label: Price
price.tooltip: The purchase cost of this auxiliary equipment.

power_consumption.label: Power Cons.
power_consumption.tooltip: The additional electrical power consumed by this equipment.

water_consumption_short.label: Water Cons.
water_consumption_short.tooltip: The specific water consumption generated by this equipment.

setupBuilder.no_setups_title: No setups stored in memory yet.
setupBuilder.no_setups_subtitle: Create your first configuration on the left.

deleteModal.title: Delete configuration
deleteModal.text: Are you sure you want to delete this configuration? This action cannot be undone.
